name: Duskwood: turning in 'Addle's Stead' to Julie Addle plays the reunion and credits 'May We Be Reunited'
contract: When the second 'Addle's Stead' (254089) is turned in to Julie Addle 254906, the caged worgen and Julie hold their recorded talk (MatodanDLC jLBZUj7KUhw, 2026-07-20, 1:51:37-1:52:24) and Julie then casts 'Arvis Reunion Credit' 355229, which gives the 254905 credit of 254091 'May We Be Reunited' to every player within 30 yards. A player who takes 254091 from Julie right after the turn-in and never talks to the worgen again must get the credit once the talk ends, about 51 seconds later.
